name: Cross Plus Inc.
summary: Cross Plus Inc. plans, makes and sells apparel and non-apparel products in Japan, including wholesale of women's and men's clothing, fashion accessories, lifestyle goods and cosmetics, plus related consulting. It also provides child development support, including therapeutic support for preschoolers with developmental disabilities. Formerly Sakuraya Shoji Co., Ltd., it was renamed in 2001, formed in 1951 and has its head office in Nagoya, Japan.
